title: Correct time for AB
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 2 seconds.

title: Correct friction coefficient
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be μ₂ = 0.5.

title: Newton's law on AB
description: Important: The student must apply Newton's second law on the horizontal track to find acceleration a₁ = (F - μ₁mg)/m.

title: Kinematics on AB
description: Important: The student must correctly use the kinematic equation x₁ = ½ a₁ t² to relate displacement, acceleration, and time.

title: Velocity at B
description: Important: The student must calculate the velocity at point B (v = a₁t = 10 m/s) and use it as the initial speed for the incline.

title: Newton's law on BC
description: Important: The student must apply Newton's second law on the incline to find a₂ = -g(sinθ + μ₂cosθ).

title: Kinematics on BC
description: Important: The student must use the correct kinematic relation (v_f² = v_i² + 2a₂x₂) with final velocity zero at point C.

title: Sign error on incline
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for the acceleration on BC (e.g., forgetting both gravity and friction oppose motion).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's working should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (kg, m, s, N).
